rating_reason: 4x at US supermarkets and 4x at restaurants makes this the strongest card for families who eat at home and go out regularly. The $120 dining credit and $120 Uber Cash bring the effective annual cost down to about $10, making it competitive even against no-fee cards for heavy grocery and dining spenders. Welcome offers vary — see terms.
best_for: families spending $300 or more a month on groceries
people who eat out regularly and want to earn on both restaurants and supermarkets
skip_if: you spend less than $200 a month on groceries and dining combined; the Blue Cash Preferred will likely earn more for you
